title: The Deadliest Animal on Earth
lines: The deadliest animal on Earth isn't a shark. | It's not even close.
Sharks kill about six people a year.
Snakes kill up to a hundred and thirty-eight thousand. | Many of them {farmers,/~farmers,} far from a hospital.
Dogs: about sixty thousand, | almost all from rabies.
Humans kill more than four hundred {thousand/~thousand} of each other every year.
But number one is tiny. | The mosquito. | It also spreads dengue, Zika and yellow fever.
Malaria alone killed six hundred and ten thousand people in {2024~twenty twenty-four}, | most of them children under five.
Which animal scares you the most? | Tell me in the comments.
